Here's a few general tips. In addition, we strongly recommend using the [QGIS User Manual](https://docs.qgis.org/3.40/en/docs/user_manual/index.html).

## Keyboard Shortcuts

| Shortcut | Description |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>F6</kbd> | Open Attribute Table |
| <kbd>F7</kbd> | Open Layer Styling Panel |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>T</kbd> | Toggle Processing Toolbox |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>J</kbd> | Zoom to Selection |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Tab</kbd> | Toggle Panel Visibility (toolbars still visible) |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>Tab</kbd> | Toggle Map Only (good for georeferencing) |
| <kbd>F11</kbd> | Toggle Full Screen |

## Plugins

Close to 3000 plugins are available to install and add functionalities to QGIS. You can install them with `Plugins > Manage and Install Plugins...` but you might find it easier to explore the catalogue using the [plugins website](https://plugins.qgis.org/plugins/).

Here are some example plugins to try:

* **QuickMapServices** to quickly load a variety of basemaps
* **QuickOSM** to download specific OpenStreetMap vector data
* **AusMap** to load a variety of Australian dataset
* **qgis2web** to convert a QGIS project to an interactive web map
* **QField Sync** to sync your projects with your QField account
